notes.title: Teji, my beloved Dachshund passed away.
notes.content: [p]Hi[/p][p]I just want to let you, the people who have bought this game and supported me, know that I’m afraid I cannot continue working. My beautiful Dachshund, Teji, who was 13 years and 7 months old, passed away three weeks ago. I didn’t have her for very long, we were together for her last 3 years and 2 months , and I really feel it wasn’t enough time. I loved her so much. She was my constant companion during all this time, always by my side while I worked in isolation on this game. Honestly, I think I could have given her more time if I hadn’t been so focused on working, and I’m filled with regrets… so many “if only” thoughts. I’m in so much pain right now that I can’t even look at her photos. I love her deeply, and I miss her beyond words.[/p][p]She was my companion, my emotional support, my angel. I have been a very lonely person all my life, and she showed me what love truly is. With her, I never felt alone. Now everything feels empty. I’m also upset because of all the neglect she endured earlier in her life ,  her former owners had her for so many years and only made her suffer, letting her heart get sick. It’s so unfair that we only had 3 years together. I tried to make those years the best of her life: peaceful, happy, surrounded by love, with no more separation anxiety, no more loneliness , only kind words, cuddles, and peace. I miss you, Teji. I don’t know what I’m going to do without you. I have never feel so much pain in my life before.[/p][p]Right now, I don’t have the strength to continue working on this game , a game whose constant theme is death… I just can’t do it[/p][p]-Sergio C.[/p]

notes.title: Update Patch 12 July 2025- Chapter 2 Added:
notes.content:
-Chapter 2 Added to the game.
-Narrative elements added
-Pistol is more reliable ( full accuracy headshots can trigger critical head explosions)
-Changes in the running stamina logic.
-Corrected some critical bugs while the zombies bites
-Added CheckPoints

Hope you enjoy this new update, more missions are coming !

notes.title: Huge Rework on the Game (26 May 2025)
notes.content:
Hi everyone, and thank you for playing the Early Access of Hordes of the Dead (previously called Dead Mist).

As you can see, I’ve rebuilt the entire experience — world, camera, perspective, character controller, bite animations, weapons, levels, and atmosphere.

The zombies now have a new gore system, improved AI, new animations, and fresh ways to surround you and kill you.

I hope you’ve enjoyed it so far. I’ll continue updating the game — I’m planning to add more missions and levels throughout this month.

Stay tuned!

— Sergio

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524417/af53fe108e82d325aa98622f75c3b1bfd52602a1.png[/img]

Hello Everybody !
First at all I want to thank to all players who have bought the game, it really means a lot to me, your support is valuable and I couldnt continue this project without you guys.
so,
Im glad top announce that multiplayer have been implemented, 
it still have bugs but is working and you can try it with a friend.

Im planning release a mobile version too (for free), where you can have clients to join your server but not create servers.. let me know if you think that is fair to release a free mobile version that could be used as demo.
Of course I have planned that All features (new levels ) of the game will be on the paid steam version.

if you like this game, please share it to your friends, it will help me a lot.
 
Thanks.
Sergio Castillo
